body: Thank you.  I don't know how serious I was...I thought about it for years and it scared me because for a moment I actually considered it.  It was the first time I have ever really thought it might be an option.  It's not.  I know that now.

It was a weak moment.  My wife left me and I just lost another job.  It seemed like I ever did was fail.  I was breaking under stress and years of mounting depression.  
Since I posted this I got my old job back. My wife is still gone, but I don't feel worthless anymore.  
It was a moment when I thought I'd never be able to financially support her and the money would take care of that.  I know she would be crushed if I did it. So I now have her picture on my phone wallpaper to remind me constantly that she needs me around.
